repos_data.description: A minimal, opinionated set of ZSH plugins designed to be small, simple, and focused.
💥 A curated list of Terminal frameworks, plugins & resources for CLI lovers.
Modular configuration system for the Z shell (ZSH)
Lightweight ZSH theme (ASCII only) via promptinit

A powerful Zsh environment setup with Oh My Posh themes, essential plugins, and advanced search capabilities. This repository provides scripts to automatically configure your terminal with modern features and aesthetics.
Zshify is a minimalistic, one command installation to customize the prompt of your Zshell or Zsh!
A simple ZSH framework for managing plugins, themes, functions, aliases and environment variables
A collection of ZSH frameworks, plugins, themes and tutorials.

🚀 Comprehensive Zsh environment manager with 42+ plugins, 5 themes, configuration profiles, and service installation. Features interactive CLI, automatic updates, resume-on-interrupt, and Oh My Zsh integration. Supports macOS, Linux, and WSL2.

🙃   A delightful community-driven (with 2,500+ contributors) framework for managing your zsh configuration. Includes 300+ optional plugins (rails, git, macOS, hub, docker, homebrew, node, php, python, etc), 140+ themes to spice up your morning, and an auto-update tool that makes it easy to keep up with the latest updates from the community.

repo_meta_data.description: Tiny and lightweight zsh configuration environment for special customization needs. It includes plugins, themes and a basic convenient setup.
